mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,event_type,event_version,occurred_at,aggregate_type, aggregate_id,trace_id,payload,retry_count FROM integration_event_outbox WHERE status = 'NEW' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 'PUBLISHING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_event_outbox SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{micros},NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)
UPDATE integration_event_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=NOW(3), lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)

UPDATE integration_event_outbox SET status='FAILED', retry_count=retry_count+1,next_retry_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{micros},NOW(3)), lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)
UPDATE integration_event_outbox SET status='NEW',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM integration_event_outbox WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
